steps.title: Your Select One routine in six steps
steps.intro: A thermal treatment: the product is applied, left in, then sealed with heat.
items: Wash hair twice with a clarifying or anti-residue shampoo. Towel dry until damp, not dripping.
Section hair into four parts. Apply evenly from roots to ends with a tint brush, strand by strand.
Leave on for 30–60 minutes depending on hair thickness and texture. Do not rinse.
Blow dry hair completely on medium heat.
Flat iron each thin section at 450°F (230°C), 10–15 passes per strand.
Let hair rest for 48 hours before the first wash.
steps.note: Before you start: always read and follow the directions on the product label. Do a strand and skin test 48 hours before full application. Use in a well-ventilated area and take care with hot tools. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using any chemical hair treatment.

faq: Select One is a professional Brazilian smoothing treatment from Prohall Professional. It aligns hair and controls excessive volume and frizz while delivering deep hydration and conditioning, using the Lumini System with Coconut Oil, Hydrolyzed Collagen and Lactic Acid.
Which hair types is it for?
Select One is suitable for all hair types, including chemically treated hair.
Can I use it at home?
Select One is designed for salon professionals, and it can also be applied at home with proper technique. Follow the label directions carefully and use a flat iron you are comfortable with.
How long should I wait before washing my hair?
Let your hair rest for 48 hours after the treatment before the first wash.
